title: "Unpublished" style of rendered entities is not accessible (and looks bad)

latest.text: Adding the ‘unpublished’ flag or the text label is an improvement on just using the pink shading alone as the text label spells out the content moderation state to the user I had a look at how other CMS products handle this to see if there
